description: Labelled customer requests for the voice/text service matcher. 'relevant' lists every catalog service that correctly answers the request (the seeded catalog has overlapping generic and Rajshahi entries, e.g. 'Plumbing' and 'Plumbing Help'). An empty list means the request is outside the catalog and the correct behaviour is to return no match. Labels were written before the matcher was run.
